These five stock groups could rally after Democrats' midterms sweep, analysts say

Democrats swept in the U.S. midterm elections this week, and that could be a boon for several groups of stocks. Clean energy firms, specialty REITs and airline companies and others may be beneficiaries of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, per Wall Street analysts.
Nasdaq futures fall on Nvidia concerns - Here are the key Wall Street triggers for the week

Futures linked to the Nasdaq fell as much as 150 points on Sunday evening local time in the US as trading resumed after the weekend break. Concerns over Nvidia Co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang being under investigation for his relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, could have potential implications for the entire tech sector.
Tamil Nadu, Kerala to face more rain; Delhi air quality worsens

Rainfall will likely continue across parts of southern India on Monday, November 9, with isolated heavy rain forecast over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal, according to the India Meteorological Department. The IMD has forecast isolated to scattered rainfall over Kerala and Mahe, Lakshadweep and Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal through Monday.
Pete Hegseth to be impeached? Potential US House Speaker Hakeem Jeffries gives a 'hard yes'

House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries backed impeaching Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth, saying he’s a “hard yes” on a measure that may be introduced as soon as this week. House Democrats plan to discuss the potential resolution on Tuesday when they convene for the first time since winning both chambers of Congress in the midterm elections, he said.
Lamborghini Temerario Tettonero Capsule: What makes this 920hp supercar different

Lamborghini has introduced the Temerario Tettonero Capsule, a limited-edition version of its V8 plug-in hybrid supercar. Limited to 499 units globally, the special edition gets a two-tone exterior, five colour options and exclusive cabin details. It retains the standard Temerario's 920hp hybrid powertrain, comprising a 4.0-litre twin-turbocharged V8 engine and three electric motors.
99 of world's 100 most polluted cities are in India; Punjab takes top two spots

A day after Diwali, 99 out of the 100 most polluted cities in the world are in India. Topping the list are two cities from Punjab — Bathinda and Faridkot — with Air Quality Index of 902 and 892, respectively. New Delhi took third with hazardous air quality and an index of 773, according to AQI at 7 am.
Nifty 50 had its best week in six years, and the MTF book may have also played its part

The Nifty 50 index gained 7.5% in the week gone by led mainly by the large-cap stocks that took the index from the lows of 22,500 to past 25,000 levels by the time trading closed on Friday. The rally seen in large-cap stocks could have also been accelerated due to one significant factor - the bearish leveraged positions that got liquidated.
Only 2 international funds currently open to fresh investments, 1 to new SIPs: Here's why

Investors looking to gain exposure to overseas markets through international mutual funds have limited options, with most schemes continuing to restrict fresh inflows. According to an analysis by Value Research, only two of the 60 international mutual fund schemes tracked are accepting fresh lump-sum investments.
Cryptocurrencies slide to two-month lows after US midterms

Cryptocurrencies fell sharply in late Sunday trade, with bitcoin and ether touching their lowest levels for more than two months, as investors fretted a Democratic Party-controlled US Congress will toughen regulation on the asset class.
Samvat 2083: How investors should approach SIPs, mutual fund switches and portfolio rebalancing

The beginning of a new Samvat year is an opportunity for investors to review their mutual fund portfolios, assess their asset allocation and check whether their investments remain aligned with their financial goals. With market participants expecting earnings growth to drive equity returns in Samvat 2083.
